# MyDinoRun

> Play the Dinosaur Game online for free with a global leaderboard, seven game modes, and power-ups. No downloads, no registration.

## Main game
- https://mydinorun.com/: Juego del dinosaurio online (Spanish homepage).
- https://mydinorun.com/en/: Play the Dinosaur Game online (English homepage).

## Guides (Spanish)
- https://mydinorun.com/como-jugar-dino-runner: Cómo jugar.
- https://mydinorun.com/ranking-dino-runner-como-escalar: Cómo escalar en el ranking.
- https://mydinorun.com/estrategia-avanzada-5000-puntos: Estrategia avanzada.
- https://mydinorun.com/power-ups-dino-runner: Power-ups.
